這個網站一直在長大。每次加了新功能、改了什麼，我們都會記在這裡，: This website keeps growing. Every time we add a feature or change something, we note it here,
讓一路陪著我們的你，也能一起看見它的變化。: so that you, who have been with us along the way, can watch it change too.

新功能：今日點燈、雙人配對卡: New: Daily Glow and Pair Card
做完語根測驗之後，可以每天回來點一下今天的狀態，想起自己回到穩定的方法；也可以把: After the Root Code Test, you can come back each day to tap how you are and remember how you get back to steady. You can also send a link to a friend and see how you work together. Both are under Tests in the main menu.
語根名稱可以直接點進介紹頁: Root names now link to their pages
在個人報告書和測驗結果裡看到的語根名稱，點下去就能讀到那個語根的完整介紹。首頁的: Root names in your personal report and test results now link to each root's full page. The counter on the home page also started including the new test.
頻率筆記改放創辦人在 Threads 上的原文，一共 19 篇，每篇都附原文連結: Frequency Notes now carry the founder's original Threads posts, 19 in all, each with a link to the original and a new cover. Frequency Notes and the message wall are also available in English.
右上角可以切換繁中、简中、EN。英文版包含首頁、關於我們、12 語根、三關測驗、: Switch languages at the top right: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese or English. The English version covers the home page, About, the 12 Root Codes, the three-stage test, the report, the Frequency Grid and the privacy policy.
新增留言牆，收錄大家在報名表和測驗回饋裡寫給我們的話，包括 2025 年 12: A new message wall gathers what people wrote to us in sign-up forms and test feedback, including notes from the December 2025 concert. We also started the Frequency Notes column.
完整測驗：三關一次做完: The full test: three stages in one go
語根、內在原型、內在動力三個測驗串成三關。每做完一關就先看到那一關的結果，中途離: The Root Code, Inner Archetype and Inner Drive tests now run as three stages. You see each result as you go, can leave and pick up again on the same device, and get your full report when all three are done.
每一個做完測驗的人，都會在網格裡點亮一格。我們也放進了舊測驗平台從 2025 年: Everyone who finishes the test lights up a cell in the grid. We also added results from the old test platform since August 2025, so we can all see how far we've come.
語根測驗改成 24 題的平衡版，加入同分時的決勝題，以及 144 句頻率任務語。: The Root Code Test is now a balanced 24-question version, with tie-break questions and 144 Mission Lines.
12 語根介紹頁: A page for each of the 12 Root Codes
每個語根都有自己的頁面：特質、穩定與失衡時的樣子、主題曲與小故事、代表顏色。: Each root now has its own page: traits, how it looks when steady and off balance, a theme song and story, and its colors.
全新的首頁、關於我們與三大測驗頁上線，金色光塔成為我們的新圖示。: A brand-new home page, About page and Tests page went live, and the golden light tower became our new icon.
首頁和 12 語根總覽裡「已累積多少筆測驗數據」的那兩句，現在會加上新版測驗的即: The two lines on the home page and the 12 Root Codes overview that say how many test results we have now include live results from the new test. Each time someone finishes, the number goes up by one.
從今天開始，網站每次加了新功能、改了什麼，都會記在這一頁。每一頁最下方都找得到它: From today, every new feature and change on the website will be recorded on this page. You can find it at the bottom of every page.
更新紀錄更好找了: Site updates are easier to find
主選單「關於我們」底下，和首頁的頻率筆記下方，都能直接點進網站更新紀錄；首頁也會: You can now open the site updates from under About in the main menu and below Frequency Notes on the home page. The home page also shows the latest update.
新增 2 分鐘小遊戲：這一趟，從哪顆星出發: New 2-minute game: Which star do you set out from?
想像每個人出發之前，都來自某一顆星。走完 8 個人生階段，每一關三個選擇，大約: Imagine that before each of us set out, we all came from a star. Walk through 8 stages of life, with three choices at each one, in about 2 minutes. You’ll find it on the home page, just below the three tests.
新增「世界觀」頁：我們怎麼看人，和這個世界: New "Worldview" page: how we see people, and the world
一張圖看懂大框架，再分四段往下讀，每段附上創辦人 Molly 的原話。主選單「關: One picture of the big frame, then four sections to read on, each with the founder Molly's own words. Find it under About in the main menu.
主選單整理好了，測驗與語根頁也更好讀: The main menu is tidied up, and the tests and root pages read more easily
上面只留世界觀、語根系統、語根測驗、Blog，其他收進「更多」（頻率筆記、網站更: The top bar now keeps only Worldview, Root Codes, the Root Code Test and Blog; everything else sits under More (Frequency Notes and the site updates are in there too), and on phones it stays one row of text. The test entry page has a new “How the three stages go” flow chart, each test now opens with “How to answer”, and the “When steady” and “When off balance” sections on all 12 root pages are now side-by-side tables. The test count on the home page, the Root Codes page and the About page now shows the same live number.
首頁一張圖看懂頻率文明，語根與筆記也更好找: The home page shows Frequency Civilization in one picture, and root codes and notes are easier to find
首頁新增「一張圖看懂頻率文明」，五個步驟一眼看完，12 個語根也排成小卡牆，滑過: The home page has a new “Frequency Civilization in one picture” that shows five steps at a glance, and the 12 root codes are laid out as small cards: hover or tap one to see its one-line description. The Root Codes page now has an overview table of all 12, with name, one line and signature colour together; the Frequency Notes list shows a date and a category on every note.
世界觀系列 01：劇本與課題，從忘記到記起: Worldview series 01: Script and lessons, from forgetting to remembering
世界觀新增第一篇延伸閱讀：一張圖說明「劇本」是什麼、哪些是信念、哪些是可以檢查的: The Worldview now has its first deeper read: one picture explaining what the “script” is and which parts are belief and which can be checked, then three sections to read on: from forgetting to remembering, lessons come but how you play them is yours, and how we respond can be practiced. To read more, start from section 01 of the Worldview page.
主選單調整：關於我們放到最前面: Main menu update: About us moves to the very front
上方選單現在是關於我們、世界觀、語根系統、語根測驗，其他項目收在「更多」裡；手機: The top bar is now About us, Worldview, Root Codes and Root Code Test; everything else sits under More. On phones it is still one row of text.
隱私權政策補充：電子報寄送服務: Privacy policy update: how newsletters are sent
隱私權政策補上一句說明：電子報與測驗結果信透過 Brevo（電子郵件寄送服務）寄: The privacy policy now says that newsletters and result emails are sent through Brevo, an email delivery service, which processes your email address only on our instructions, for sending these emails.
世界觀系列 02：一句話，怎麼寫出現實: Worldview series 02: One sentence, and how it writes reality
世界觀新增第二篇延伸閱讀：一張兩列的圖，把「我們相信的」和「可以檢查的」上下對照: Worldview has a second piece of further reading: a two-row diagram that sets what we believe against what can be checked, then five sections to read through. The small tag at the end of each section tells you whether it is a belief, a choice, or something that can be checked; where research exists to look to, the full source is given.
上方選單：世界觀可以展開，每一篇都收進來: Top menu: Worldview now opens up, with every piece inside
上方選單的「世界觀」旁多了一個小箭頭，點開可以直接進到世界觀總覽和世界觀系列的每: There is now a small arrow next to “Worldview” in the top menu. Open it to go straight to the Worldview overview and to every piece in the Worldview series. Clicking the word “Worldview” itself still takes you to the overview. On a phone, tap the small arrow to open it; on a computer, it opens when you move over it.
世界觀系列 03：所有聲音都聽，方向盤在現在的你手上: Worldview series 03: Hear every voice; the wheel is in your hands
世界觀新增第三篇延伸閱讀：心裡有擔心、直覺，身體也在傳訊息時，怎麼把每個聲音都聽: Worldview has a third piece of further reading: when worry and intuition are both speaking and the body is sending messages too, how to hear every voice and then let the “me of now” decide. One diagram shows how the three sources come together, then five sections to read through, ending with a small three-second-pause practice.
世界觀系列 04：不必耗到崩潰，才肯停下來: Worldview series 04: You don't have to break down before you stop
世界觀新增第四篇延伸閱讀：身體不只是載著你往前跑的工具，也是和你一起開車的夥伴。: Worldview has a fourth piece of further reading: your body is not just a vehicle that carries you forward; it is also a partner driving with you. Five sections to read through: one car, two drivers; the body as the one who carries things out, and as a partner; what research says about sleep, stress and judgment; which strength is at the wheel when you push on while tired; and finally a 30-second daily practice of checking on the car.
